scenes.description: Kim is sitting at a table in the office break room, sipping tea while coughing occasionally. Her colleagues Mona and Leo approach her, clearly concerned about her health.

actions.dialogue: Kim, are you okay? You've been coughing a lot. Have you thought about going home and resting today?
I really want to, but I don’t want to fall behind on the project. Plus, I promised my friend I’d go to dinner tonight, and my cat needs me to come home to feed it.
Hey, we can help out with the project if you need to take the afternoon off. Your health is more important, and your cat can wait a little longer if you’re not feeling up to it.
Thanks, both of you. I really appreciate the support. It’s just hard to say no to work when there’s so much on my plate, but I know I need to take care of myself too.
You’ve been working so hard lately. It’s okay to prioritize your health and your cat. We’ll cover for you, I promise. And maybe you can reschedule the dinner if you need to rest more.

scenes.plot: Kim is struggling with whether to stay at work or go home to rest and take care of her cat. Her colleagues Mona and Leo notice her condition and offer support, helping her realize the importance of self-care and work-life balance.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate how Kim's values (health, responsibility, friendship, self-care) and personality traits (considerate, responsible, caring, anxious) influence her decision-making in a social and professional context.
